jobs.title: AI Animation Filmmaker for Hindi Horror Storytelling YouTube Channel
jobs.description:
I am looking for an experienced AI animation filmmaker/video creator to produce a 10–12-minute cinematic 2D horror cartoon episode for my Hindi horror storytelling YouTube channel.  

Job Responsibilities:  
- Full story script breakdown and scene planning.  
- Character design and consistency.  
- Create backgrounds/environments.  
- 2D animated scenes using tools like AutoDraft, Cinema Studio, or hybrid AI workflows.  
- Character expressions, movements, lip-sync with dialogue.  
- Record Hindi narration and separate character voices.  
- Add background music, sound effects, and transitions.
